title: Early Australian Voyages: Pelsart, Tasman, Dampier

author: John Pinkerton
description: "Early Australian Voyages: Pelsart, Tasman, Dampier" by John Pinkerton is a historical account written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: The book recounts significant early voyages to Australia, particularly focusing on the explorations of Captain Francis Pelsart, Abel Tasman, and William Dampier.

authorInfo.bio: John Pinkerton (1758–1826) wrote Early Australian Voyages: Pelsart, Tasman, Dampier. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
